description: LLM/human orientation index: maps design-milestone-style work to owning task/*.Rmd files and suggested validation. Completion criteria always live in those task files and sv0doc/ — not in this JSON. Optional keys automation_profile, ground_truth, human_checkpoints, and success_signals add agent-workflow depth (see task/agent-workflow-and-milestone-tracking.md); they do not replace closure_authority or owning-task prose.

milestones.title: Formal language spec (sv0doc hub)
milestones.closure_authority: Completion/story in task/sv0doc-milestone-0.Rmd; normative text in sv0doc/.
anti_patterns: Treat README or rules as normative semantics over sv0doc/
milestones.automation_profile: Predefined workflow (prompt chaining in tasks + test-guards); human-in-the-loop for semantics and spec-vs-vision alignment.
human_checkpoints: New normative behavior not yet stated in sv0doc/
Resolving contradictions between external vision docs and sv0doc/
success_signals: Owning sv0doc milestone task updated with completion evidence
test-guards passes after spec or task index changes

milestones.title: Bootstrap SML compiler (through C/VM backends)
milestones.automation_profile: Workflow + evaluator–optimizer loop: implement slice → named local targets (vm-compile / emit-c) → escalate to full test when lists or sml/ move.
human_checkpoints: Bytecode or language semantics change without prior sv0doc/ update (when that is the agreed order)

milestones.title: Bytecode VM + sv0c VM backend
milestones.closure_authority: task/sv0vm-milestone-2.Rmd (VM) + compiler backend linkage in sv0c tasks.
milestones.automation_profile: Workflow with parallelizable recon (sv0vm vs sv0c paths); goldens and parity harnesses supply ground truth for bytecode-visible changes.
ground_truth: sv0vm/ and sv0c/ test corpora and golden outputs where applicable
human_checkpoints: Opcode or loader layout changes that invalidate large golden sets (plan refresh explicitly)
success_signals: VM task criteria met with named test commands
Submodule PROGRESS.md updated when behavior or corpus moved

milestones.title: Toolchain prep: unified test, doctest, fmt, doc, lib/ bootstrap track
milestones.automation_profile: Orchestration-heavy workflow: list files, orchestration scripts, and CI wiring — strong fit for transparent, named commands as gates.
ground_truth: lib/bootstrap-sources.list and related manifests when touched
human_checkpoints: Changing default developer commands or CI stages (stakeholder-visible)
success_signals: Prep task acceptance items checked with evidence
test + guards green after orchestration edits

milestones.title: Self-hosting compiler in sv0 (parity + bootstrap story)
milestones.closure_authority: Stakeholder completion criteria in task/sv0-toolchain-milestone-3-self-host.Rmd (feature parity, VM policy, native self-host, SML retirement) — not pilot list growth alone.
anti_patterns: Claim M3 complete because lib/self-host-sv0-loop.list is green
Tag bootstrap-sml-final or move sml/ to sml-legacy/ before that task allows it
milestones.automation_profile: Long-horizon workflow plus orchestrator–workers: slash-command phases, optional Task subagents per submodule, evaluator–optimizer on red tests/CI; judgment against task bars is not fully automatable.
ground_truth: ./scripts/sv0 test (and SV0_SKIP_SELF_HOST_COMPILER_DIFF=1 only as a documented intermediate)
sv0c/lib/golden/stage0/ and sv0c/test/vm-parity/golden/sml/ when those slices move
gh run watch after integration pushes
human_checkpoints: M3 completion or SML retirement scope reinterpretation
Any commit that assumes new language semantics not in sv0doc/
success_signals: M3 task + checklist evidence aligned with anti_patterns unused
Progress ledger row with exact validation commands (40-validation-and-proof)

milestones.title: Advanced verification
milestones.automation_profile: Workflow leaning on extended test and proof artifacts; likely parallel tracks for checker vs runtime proof plumbing once scoped.
ground_truth: Milestone-4 task criteria and any dedicated proof/test subdirs it defines
human_checkpoints: What counts as 'verified' for a given language feature (task-level contract)
success_signals: M4 task sections explicitly satisfied with cited commands or artifacts

milestones.title: LLVM + production crypto
milestones.automation_profile: Future workflow: spec-first for crypto and backend contracts, then implementation slices with tiered validation (guards → targeted backend tests → full test).
ground_truth: sv0doc/ for algorithms and safety contracts
Upstream toolchain expectations (LLVM, crypto libs) as documented in the task
human_checkpoints: Dependency and licensing choices for crypto or LLVM stacks
success_signals: M5 task acceptance items met with named evidence

milestones.title: Kernel / bare metal
milestones.automation_profile: Future workflow: spec and platform constraints drive small verified slices; heavy human checkpointing on ABI, boot, and hardware assumptions.
ground_truth: sv0doc/ and M6 task for platform contracts
Hardware/emulator test commands once defined in the task
human_checkpoints: Target ISA, boot protocol, and unsafe boundary policy
success_signals: M6 task criteria checked with reproducible command list

milestones.title: Cross-cutting backlog (macros, literate, std, packaging)
milestones.automation_profile: Router-first: pick owning submodule and milestone from the backlog item before coding; otherwise use orchestrator–workers with disjoint scopes only.
human_checkpoints: Public CLI or repo layout changes affecting multiple submodules
success_signals: Backlog item tied to a primary milestone id with evidence in that task

milestones.title: MCP server + dev graph
milestones.automation_profile: Service workflow: config + sync commands as gates; optional tools (Neo4j) — document ground truth commands in sv0-mcp/README.md.
ground_truth: sv0-mcp/README.md documented checks (e.g. ruff, compose config)
human_checkpoints: Graph schema or sync semantics that mirror normative sv0doc/ layout changes
success_signals: Graph sync run recorded when tasks or sv0doc/ layout required it

milestones.title: Full roadmap index (option C)
milestones.closure_authority: Roadmap is an index — milestone closure is per owning task/*.Rmd, not this file alone.
anti_patterns: Declare design milestone 3 closed from roadmap hygiene only
milestones.automation_profile: Indexing workflow: roadmap verify script + guards; routing readers to milestone-orient show <id> for real closure authority.
human_checkpoints: Reinterpreting design milestone boundaries (vision vs tracked tasks)
success_signals: Index tables stay consistent with verify_workspace_milestone_table
